test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

LG - MH - OP

HC - ID - KL
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

LG - MH - OP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce29d98e1965e534a5f524a30befde832de5c46a583aaf006c95110ee3f7f43d.png] 

And,

HC - ID - KL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/346fa4329db705e2b555349bec7df4e486de28895cdec953620c9aadefd95947.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) OJ - PK - RT 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ed06ac0667a259211736005227991b92796c650d87f664d1deadddc1eb85e0b.png] 

Option 2) KF - LG - NP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c516d0b9c14525719daef3bad0a33d96401eae21b80657d1493c8f9cb6f7ed3.png] 

Option 3) JE - KF - MN 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/840d0babf3d7f558c4d544e342104bbf6b5ed9c93d6eda2462c85046b2cdc683.png] 

Option 4) ID - JE - LN 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4354e2888f2f85fad1b4afd04a3ea7e5ed2bf0a671d786a3b2c1b272be6e5125.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'JE - KF - MN ' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
